name: New Era
verdict: New Era Cap is controlled by its founding Koch family; private equity firm ACON Investments holds a significant minority stake. Nothing found.
note: Official Cap of LIV Golf and all 13 teams (livgolf.com/partners, fetched 2026-09-25); Fireballs GC partner on livgolf.com/fireballs-gc (verified in the page HTML, 2026-10-03). Reuters (via FashionNetwork, September 2023) reported the company is controlled by its founding family with ACON Investments holding a significant minority stake (new-era-koch-family-ownership). No state or state-fund owner found, no human-rights finding found.
